findings.title: Discussion post body rendered unescaped with th:utext
findings.sink: th:utext rendering of rich-text fields (no shared HTML sanitizer)
findings.description: Discussion posts are stored as rich text and rendered with th:utext, which outputs raw HTML. A student can post markup that runs script in the browser of every classmate and instructor who opens the thread.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled globally
findings.description: SecurityConfig disables CSRF protection for all routes with http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()). Grade submission and enrollment changes use session cookies, so a malicious page can submit them on behalf of a logged-in instructor.

findings.title: Path traversal in course file download
findings.description: The download endpoint joins the user-supplied name parameter onto the course storage directory without normalizing it. Relative path segments let a user read files outside the course folder, including application configuration.

findings.title: Outdated jackson-databind with published advisories
findings.description: pom.xml pins jackson-databind 2.13.2, which has published deserialization advisories, and polymorphic typing is enabled on one ObjectMapper.

findings.cweName: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
findings.title: Error pages include stack traces
findings.description: server.error.include-stacktrace is set to always, so error pages show stack traces with class names and SQL statements.

findings.cweName: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts
findings.title: No lockout on student and instructor login
findings.description: Failed logins are not counted, so student and instructor passwords can be guessed without limit.

findings.title: Remember-me cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure
findings.description: The remember-me cookie is issued without HttpOnly or Secure, so scripts can read it and it is sent over plain HTTP.
